target.statement: Number of successful runs (out of 100) forming the expected number of clusters for a given algorithm/dataset/cluster-count combination, e.g. FGWC+ABC on the East Java dengue dataset (Case 2) with c=2
target.dataset: East Java dengue fever (Case 2, 9 indicators, district level)

compute.basis: The R package and bundled census data are public, but the East Java dengue dataset is not clearly downloadable and the full protocol is 100 stochastic runs x 7 algorithms x 5 cluster counts x 3 datasets at 1000 iterations, so a single cell still requires re-running a large simulation grid on CPU.

blockers: East Java dengue dataset (Case 2) not clearly provided in the linked repo
Full protocol is 100 repetitions x 7 algorithms x 5 cluster counts x 3 datasets, expensive on CPU
Results are stochastic; exact success counts may not match without the original seeds
title: naspaclust: A hybridisation of spatial fuzzy clustering with nature-inspired optimisation
